mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when PAYEMS > 130K & UNRATE < 9.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals decreased supply chain pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of instances when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above 350B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% & CPIAUCSL > 220, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 10% signals labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high UNRATE periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift from residential to non-residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and housing market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 30% of instances when GDPC1 > 13000B & HOUST < 500K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
